items.title: Full-stack observational Fishtank showcase, proximity-radius fix + safe spawn (fix of V3-EXQ-906a)
items.note: Bug-fix lettered iteration of V3-EXQ-906a (2026-08-09), routed by the user-confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-906a_894b_2026-08-09.md (Target 1). GOV-REUSE-1: no prior manifest carries a fixed-proximity-radius readout for this combined-flag config -- not recoverable, run. ROOT CAUSE: 906a fixed 2 of 3 independent health-drain channels (contamination_spread, hazard_harm) but left a third untouched -- proximity-approach damage (causal_grid_world.py ~2445-2469), which drains health on any step the agent is merely near a hazard's field, no contact required. 906a's scored run: 8/8 segments ended health_depleted, mean realized segment length 25.375 steps vs the ecology_survivable threshold 59.6, with only 1 external_hazard event recorded -- consistent with ambient proximity drain, not contact, matching the user's direct fishtank_viz observation (health draining fast with no hazard hit). FIX (parameters chosen by empirical Monte-Carlo grid-search over the field formula, NOT hand arithmetic -- see module docstring points 1-2 for the full correction story): a first draft used single-hazard-radius arithmetic (proximity_approach_threshold=0.6 at the untouched hazard_field_decay=0.5) and was DISPROVED by this driver's own smoke test (_safe_reset's 20-attempt bound exhausted on both dry-run segments) -- _compute_proximity_fields() SUMS all 4 hazards' field contributions, not max, so single-hazard arithmetic under-states the true ambient background and the first draft was still ~99% grid-wide unsafe. Re-derived empirically instead: simulated 400-500 random 4-hazard layouts on the 12x12 eval grid per (decay, threshold) pair, measured P(field>=threshold | nearest-hazard Manhattan distance). Shipped: hazard_field_decay 0.5->2.5, proximity_approach_threshold 0.15->0.4 (measured P(unsafe|d=1)=0.969, P(unsafe|d=2)=0.265, P(unsafe|d>=3)~0.006, mean unsafe grid fraction ~0.19), proximity_harm_scale 0.05->0.02 (further per-step drain gentling). This puts harm onset inside the agent's fixed radius-2 (5x5) sensory window with a genuine probabilistic 'smell before harm' gap at the window's own edge -- the substrate's additive (not max) field means the radius is not perfectly sharp/config-independent, stated as a caveat in the docstring rather than smoothed over. proximity_approach_threshold is a SHARED field also gating the resource-approach benefit bonus -- both cues become close-range together, deliberately, not a hidden side effect. SAFE SPAWN: added a bounded (20-attempt) env.reset() retry per segment so no segment starts already inside the harm zone (mirrors causal_grid_world.py's own microhabitat redraw-guard pattern); smoke-verified this specifically -- spawn_attempts dropped from 20/20 (both segments exhausted, first-draft parameters) to 1/1 (both segments, final parameters). LAYOUT: num_hazards/num_resources/size deliberately left unchanged (matches what the curriculum trained on) -- the radius fix alone was empirically verified (same grid-search) to leave ~81% of the grid safe on average, vs 906a's ~100% unsafe. RECORDING-CORE BUGS FIXED (906a's manifest was missing all three): elapsed_seconds never measured (now captured via time.perf_counter() -- time.time() was tried first and produced a nonsense negative elapsed_seconds, caught by reading the smoke manifest before trusting it); result['config'] never set (write_flat_manifest's config= kwarg silently got None); seeds hardcoded to None regardless of --seeds. All three confirmed fixed via validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest (0 always-core gaps). EPISODE-LOG DELIVERY -- OPS ACTION ITEM, NOT FIXED BY THIS SCRIPT: 906a's promised episode_log was never written to disk claim was only half right -- the driver DOES write it correctly every run; it never reached origin because Phase 3's companion-file transport (PHASE3_SPOOL_SIDEFILES, coordinator/sync_daemon.py) defaults OFF and is only a .example template in coordinator/deploy/shadow.conf.{hub,worker}.example in this repo. Cannot be confirmed or fixed from a driver script or this worktree -- OPERATOR: verify PHASE3_SPOOL_SIDEFILES=1 is set on both ree-sync-daemon (hub) and ree-cloud-4 (this entry's pinned worker) before assuming this run's episode_log will land on origin/master (see coordinator/OPERATOR_GUIDE.md 'Side-file sync'); if not set, this run repeats the identical gap regardless of the driver-side companion_files declaration also added here. NOT ACTED ON HERE (by design): the autopsy's secondary finding (SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND, an unclamped RBFLayer.update_valence() accumulator in ree_core/residue/field.py) is pending /governance ratification per the autopsy-chip exception -- not this script's job. machine_affinity/estimated_minutes/episodes_per_run mirror 906a's own entry unchanged (identical curriculum + eval budgets, same substrate family, same worker).

items.title: MECH-025: action-doing mode DV redesign (C1 sign reversed per Thura & Cisek 2014 convergence; precision-ratio demoted to non-gating descriptive metric)
items.note: Finishes the routing from the confirmed failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03 (chip-20260808-mech025-doing-mode-dv-redesign; 5+ days unqueued). V3-EXQ-876 was the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 (all 3 prior instrument defects fixed, both regimes well-sampled/non-degenerate in every seed) but its C1 criterion (doing_mode_delta > 0.002) FAILed with the OPPOSITE sign in 4/5 seeds; autopsy classified this measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory because the claim's own cited literature disputes C1's sign convention (Friston 2013: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch -- flags C1's whole discrete-split framing as a formal-import mismatch; Thura & Cisek 2014, Neuron, the closer biological reference: PMd/M1 representations CONVERGE, not diverge, during commitment -- predicting a SMALLER causal-signature contrast under commitment, i.e. the negative delta V3-EXQ-876 actually observed). claims.yaml's what_would_answer (2026-08-08 digestion) offered two redesign directions: (1) flip C1's sign per Thura-Cisek, or (2) gate on precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean directly (already recorded in 876, separating 4-5 orders of magnitude every seed, never scored). THIS SCRIPT TAKES (1) AS THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION AND DEMOTES (2) TO NON-GATING: E3's commit rule is LITERALLY committed=running_variance<threshold, precision=1/variance, so 'committed steps have higher precision' is a near-tautological consequence of the substrate's OWN definition of commitment (ARC-016, already independently stable/validated), not an independently falsifiable prediction of MECH-025 -- gating on it risks a structurally-guaranteed vacuous_pass. Direction (1)'s causal_sig, by contrast, is computed from two genuinely independent E2.world_forward rollouts (actual vs a distinct randomly-sampled counterfactual action) through E3.harm_eval and is not wired to the commit rule's own variance computation at all (DV-symmetry: not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescale of a shared upstream quantity -- see module docstring for the full declaration). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout precision_committed_mean --claim MECH-025 found exactly ONE compatible manifest (v3_exq_876_..._20260802T214005Z_v3, substrate_hash 5bba8a67...) and its doing_mode_delta values are ALREADY KNOWN to this authoring session (negative in 4/5 seeds) -- reusing/reanalyzing that same data under a reversed-sign criterion would be circular (HARKing) regardless of whether done via a formal reanalysis or a relabeled rerun. NOT reused: this script runs FRESH SEEDS (11,17,29,53,71 -- disjoint from 876's [42,123,7,99,256]; none is 44, the documented reef-config instability seed) through the UNCHANGED, already-validated instrument (same SelectionResult.committed read, same agent.update_residue()-every-tick call, same BreathOscillator config) so the reversed criterion is tested against genuinely new data. C1's magnitude (0.002) is carried over UNCHANGED from 876's own pre-registered bar (only the sign flips) -- not fit to the observed effect sizes (-0.03 to -0.09, ~10-40x larger), leaving real room for the fresh run to fail too. RECORDING FIX: 876's write_flat_manifest(...,config=None,...) gap (flagged in the autopsy) is fixed here (full REEConfig passed via dataclasses.asdict, started_at wired for elapsed_seconds, z_goal_stream_stats via ZGoalStreamAccumulator). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-025 (the one confirmed autopsy is measurement_test_design_defect, action=none) -- not braked. Substrate readiness (2.5): ARC-016 stable/V3-confirmed (dynamic E3 precision), all 6 depends_on claims unblocked, confirmed via claims.yaml + ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ARC-016 sections. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entries with substrate_paths set at all. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings across every category. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 11, 5/3/30 toy schedule): ran clean, no crash, correct P0-unready self-route at toy scale (expected, not load-bearing), progress lines (ep N/M) + verdict line + precision_ratio all emit correctly. items.title: SD-016 GOV-FANOUT-1 leg H1 (DRIVE): explicit context-divergence objective on the Path-3 cue-slot tagger -- does rewarding context-conditioned divergence break the uniform-selection saddle?
items.note: SD-016 GOV-FANOUT-1 leg H1 (DRIVE axis) of the selection-mechanism discrimination portfolio designed in sd016_selection_fanout_portfolio_scope_staged_20260809.md section 3, routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-898_2026-08-08 (user-ratified). QUESTION: three independently-designed SD-016 selection mechanisms (418 q.k, 418m tagger, 898 tagger under the SD-070-trained encoder) all hit the uniform-selection saddle (sel_entropy -> ln(16)=2.7726). The unifying gap: no mechanism was ever given a training signal rewarding context-CONDITIONED divergence. H1 adds exactly that as an auxiliary loss -lambda*|mean_w_safe - mean_w_dang|_1 in P1 and asks whether the tagger leaves the saddle. DRIVER-ONLY probe, NO /implement-substrate: the _last_cue_slot_weights hook is detached (e1_deep.py:450) so the driver calls the PUBLIC agent.e1.cue_slot_tagger nn.Sequential directly (Step-2.5a probe 2026-08-09 confirmed reachable + differentiable, grad flows to all 4 tagger tensors). 5 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44]: A0_OFF (legacy q.k, C2 control), A1_tagger (matched-budget baseline = 898 ON arm, attribution), A2_ctxdiv at lambda {0.1,0.5,2.0}. LAMBDA CHOICE: a Step-2.5a foreground probe showed the objective SATURATES by lambda=0.5 (0.5 and 2.0 gave near-identical eval_div 0.2687; both left entropy at the saddle 2.737) with lambda=0 baseline at 0.0159 -- so {0.1,0.5,2.0} spans the informative pre-saturation region instead of the scope's three-saturated {0.5,1,2}; the flat top is confirmed saturation (manipulation is LIVE), not a clamp. C1 (entropy<2.5) is the FREE load-bearing scientific readout (does the drive induce SPARSE selection?); C1b (ctxdiv>0.1) is the DIRECTLY-OPTIMISED manipulation check measured held-out (did the drive take, generalising?). Full PASS = any A2 arm C1 AND C1b on majority ready seeds AND C2 control on saddle. FAIL is sub-typed into four discriminating regions (context_conditioned_not_sparse [probe-predicted -> implicates H3 / entropy floor], sparse_not_context_conditioned [constant-peaky], objective_insufficient [true null], substrate_inconsistent). NULL DECLARATION (scope 3 H1): a FAIL does NOT rule out H2/H3; a non-insufficient FAIL rules OUT 'the tagger merely lacked the right gradient'. Mandatory 898 readiness gate retained (world_encoder_weights_moved>=1, z_world_spread_lift>=1.3) so a null attributes to selection, not the encoder; full per-context selection histograms (mean_w_safe[16]/mean_w_dang[16]) recorded per cell (verdict-aliasing guard). claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; /failure-autopsy adjudication before any claims.yaml action, 418g/418m/898 precedent). GATES: 2.5b re-derive brake does NOT fire (SD-016 braking count 1 < 2, and this is a NEW-number diagnostic testing a DIFFERENT mechanism, not a lettered re-pose). 2.5c substrate-path gate CLEAR (only open overlap is mech203-valence-pool, severity unset -> no action; its harm/benefit-salience functions are not on this terrain-loss driver path).
